mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.usage_hint='SUB' OR (p.usage_hint='UNKNOWN' AND LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',p.label,p.source_label,p.external_profile_key)) REGEXP '(^|[^a-z])sub[ -]?stream([^a-z]|$)') THEN 0 WHEN p.usage_hint='MAIN' OR (p.usage_hint='UNKNOWN' AND LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',p.label,p.source_label,p.external_profile_key)) REGEXP '(^|[^a-z])main[ -]?stream([^a-z]|$)') THEN 1 WHEN p.usage_hint='THIRD' OR (p.usage_hint='UNKNOWN' AND LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',p.label,p.source_label,p.external_profile_key)) REGEXP '(^|[^a-z])third[ -]?stream([^a-z]|$)') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN p.bitrate_kbps>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN p.bitrate_kbps>0 THEN p.bitrate_kbps ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN p.width>0 AND p.height>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN p.width>0 AND p.height>0 THEN CAST(p.width AS DECIMAL(20,0))*p.height ELSE NULL END, p.id
mapper.select: SELECT selected.* FROM camera_channel c JOIN camera_stream_profile selected ON selected.id=( SELECT p.id FROM camera_stream_profile p WHERE p.channel_id=c.id AND p.enabled=1 ORDER BY LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.id
